content.heading: Property — historical Fundamental Right and current clause
content.text: Article 31 as a Fundamental Right relating to compulsory acquisition of property was omitted by the Constitution (Forty-fourth Amendment) Act, 1978. Articles 31A, 31B and 31C continue as savings/validation provisions in Part III. Article 300A provides that no person shall be deprived of property save by authority of law. Do not plead Article 31 as current Part III law.
content.historicalNotes: Art 31 FR omitted; effective transition to Art 300A for current property claims.
